thread:
Noah: Heads-up idea: introduce an 'entropy-aware' config rollout for routing/quota flags. Ramp speed adapts to observed variance (entropy) of key metrics rather than fixed time windows.

Leila: Interesting. How do you define entropy here? Shannon entropy on bucketed request outcomes? :nerd_face: 

Noah: Simple version: bucket by response outcome (200, 4xx, 5xx) and latency quantiles, compute normalized entropy over recent window. High entropy -> slow ramp / require dry-run. Low entropy -> can accelerate.

Chris: Operationally we need deterministic semantics. Suggest combining entropy score with a traffic-growth cap. e.g., max_delta_pct_per_min = base_rate * (1 - entropy). So if entropy=0.6, we only allow 40% of base growth per minute.

Noah: Exactly. Also add a minimum floor so we don't stall forever for noisy low-traffic tenants. Floor could be 0.1 of base_rate.

Leila: UX: Console should show current entropy score, recent buckets chart, and an explain link showing why rollout slowed. Also an override button saying 'Force accelerate (requires approval)'.

Chris: For API: here's a compact schema (as plain text):
POST /api/v1/rollouts/start
{
  "change":"quota_bucket.increase=+20%",
  "strategy":"entropy_aware",
  "params":"{\"base_rate\":0.02,\"min_floor\":0.1,\"lookback\":\"1h\"}",
  "notify":"team-platform"
}

Noah: We also need telemetry hooks: entropy service returns {score, buckets, sample_count}. Gate logic uses score + sample_count >= min_samples to decide. If sample_count low -> fallback to time-based rollout.

metrics-bot: entropy-probe: job id ent-441 queued for tenant acme-inc expected runtime ~90s.

Leila: Failure semantics: if error_rate increases above threshold at any point, immediately pause and rollback last step. If entropy spikes but errors remain stable, pause progression but do not rollback. Keeps changes reversible.

Chris: Cost control: enable a 'cheap-preview' which runs the strategy on sampled traffic via shadowing and returns predicted progression timeline without replaying full traffic. Expose confidence interval.

Noah: For approval: auto-approve if team role 'rollout-actor' and entropy<0.3; else route to approvers. Add audit log entry with entropy history and sim job id.

deploy-bot: cheap-preview sim ent-441 completed: predicted full ramp in ~3h (CI +/\- 20%), confidence 92%.

Leila: Next steps: Noah to draft small RFC for the entropy metric and fallback heuristics. Chris will prototype the cap function and a small simulator notebook. Ill mock the Console tiles and the override flow. Sync tomorrow 10am.

Noah: Thanks all. I'll stub the entropy-service API and add it to RFC.
